title: Thai Duck Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai curry made with tender duck and a blend of spices. Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: 1. Cut the duck breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt.
2. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
3. Add the duck to the pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Remove the duck from the pan and set aside.
5. Add the curry paste to the pan and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
6. Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, and tom yum paste (if using) to the pan.
7. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
8. Return the duck to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the duck is cooked through, about 10-15 minutes.
9. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
10. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over steamed rice or noodles.
